objective: Define and build the smallest packaged release of the bounded alpha for linux-x86_64 (daemon, grant signer, authority-node control and validator binaries, served App, harness shim, installer; signed manifest with per-file digests and SBOM), an installer that verifies against an operator-pinned signer and activates immutably installed releases, and the daemon's admitted update/rollback path (release change plans) whose outcome is observed by the daemon's own executable digest.
falsifiable_claim: A package built by scripts/package-hypervisor-alpha-release.mjs verifies under the pinned signer key and fails on a changed byte, an unlisted file, a missing file, a manifest edit or a different key; install.mjs installs it immutably and activates by symlink; a daemon running from <prefix>/current admits an update plan to a second package, refuses a no-op target and a second in-flight plan, and after the installer's activation + restart the daemon that came back observes its own digest = the target's and completes the plan with a receipt; rollback to the prior release completes the same way; the whole alpha journey passes with the daemon, App, signer and shim being the installed bytes.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: test:hypervisor-alpha-release (4/4) proves tamper, unlisted, missing, wrong-key and manifest-edit refusals; release_change_plan_routes unit tests prove the self-digest is the executable's bytes and plan ids are shape-checked; the journey's package mode proves the no-op and double-admission refusals live and observes both the update and the rollback by the daemon's own digest.
remaining_nonclaims: The packaged build is the debug cargo profile; no release-profile build is qualified.
The second release in qualification differs from the first only by the daemon crate version (same sources).
The authority node's launcher is not relocatable outside a source checkout of the packaged revision (closure test in the manifest's prerequisites.authority_node).
No update discovery/egress; material is supplied by the operator.
source_provenance: Landed 2026-09-07 by the bounded-alpha closure program (see canon-to-code-delta.md § Journey verification XVI).
